title: Multi-Scale Spectral Attention Module-based Hyperspectral Segmentation in Autonomous Driving Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2506.18682v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in autonomous driving (AD) have highlighted the potential of hyperspectral imaging (HSI) for enhanced environmental perception, particularly in challenging weather and lighting conditions. However, efficiently processing high-dimensional spectral data remains a significant challenge. This paper presents an empirical investigation of a Multi-Scale Attention Mechanism (MSAM) for enhanced spectral feature extraction through three parallel 1D convolutions with varying kernel sizes (1-11) and adaptive feature aggregation. translated_title: 基于多尺度光谱注意力模块的自动驾驶场景高光谱分割
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.18682v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：近期自动驾驶（AD）的进展凸显了高光谱成像（HSI）在增强环境感知方面的潜力，尤其是在恶劣天气和光照条件下。然而，高效处理高维光谱数据仍然是一个重大挑战。本文对一种多尺度注意力机制（MSAM）进行了实证研究，该机制通过三个具有不同核大小（1-11）的并行一维卷积和自适应特征聚合来增强光谱特征提取。通过将MSAM集成到UNet的跳跃连接中，我们评估了其在多个城市驾驶场景高光谱数据集上的语义分割性能提升。全面的消融研究表明，MSAM始终优于基线UNet-SC，在mIoU上平均提升2.32%，在mF1上平均提升2.88%，同时与已建立的注意力机制相比，保持了具有竞争力的GPU性能。
tldr: 本文提出一种多尺度光谱注意力模块（MSAM），通过并行一维卷积和自适应聚合集成到UNet跳跃连接中，在自动驾驶高光谱分割任务中显著提升mIoU和mF1，同时保持高效GPU性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Multi-Scale Spectral Attention Module (MSAM) integrated into UNet skip connections via parallel 1D convolutions and adaptive aggregation, achieving significant mIoU and mF1 improvements in autonomous driving hyperspectral segmentation while maintaining efficient GPU performance.
